name: Brookings Institution
notes: Centrist policy think tank. Qatar funding (Brookings Doha Center) is publicly disclosed.
self_description: Brookings equips decisionmakers with nonpartisan research and policy strategies to create a more prosperous and secure country and world.

name: Heritage Foundation
notes: Conservative think tank. Authored Project 2025 policy framework.
self_description: Heritage’s mission is to formulate and promote conservative public policies based on the principles of free enterprise, limited government, individual freedom, traditional American values, and a strong national defense.

name: American Enterprise Institute
notes: Free-market policy research.
self_description: a public policy think tank dedicated to defending human dignity, expanding human potential, and building a freer and safer world

name: Cato Institute
major_funders: ["Charles Koch Foundation", "Donald and Paula Smith Family Foundation", "DonorsTrust"]
notes: Libertarian think tank. Long-running Koch family backing.
self_description: assiduously nonpartisan and independent public policy research organization—or think tank—that creates a presence for and promotes libertarian ideas

name: Center for American Progress
notes: Founded by John Podesta. Closely associated with the Democratic establishment.
self_description: independent, nonpartisan policy institute … As progressives, we believe America should be a land of boundless opportunity

name: Manhattan Institute
self_description: dedicated to advancing opportunity, individual liberty, and the rule of law in America and its great cities

name: Economic Policy Institute
notes: Labor-aligned economic policy research.
self_description: a nonprofit, nonpartisan think tank working for the last 30 years to counter rising inequality, low wages and weak benefits for working people … recognized as national leaders on breakthrough liberal economic policies

name: Roosevelt Institute
self_description: Drawing on the legacy of Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt, the Roosevelt Institute champions new ideas and new leaders to make our economy and democracy work for the many, not the few.

name: Federalist Society
notes: Influential in conservative judicial nominations.
self_description: Founded in 1982, the Federalist Society for Law and Public Policy Studies is a group of conservatives and libertarians dedicated to reforming the current legal order … Beyond our statement of purpose the Federalist Society takes no public policy positions and does not participate in activism of any kind.

name: American Constitution Society
notes: Progressive counterpart to the Federalist Society.
self_description: the nation's foremost progressive legal organization

name: Federal Communications Commission
notes: Independent U.S. agency regulating interstate communications by radio, TV, wire, satellite, and cable.
governance_structure: Independent regulatory commission. Five commissioners appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate, serving five-year terms. No more than three commissioners may belong to the same political party.

name: Federal Trade Commission
notes: Independent U.S. agency that enforces antitrust law and protects consumers from deceptive practices.
governance_structure: Independent regulatory commission. Five commissioners appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate, serving seven-year terms. Not more than three commissioners may be members of the same political party.

name: United States Department of Justice
notes: Cabinet-level department responsible for federal law enforcement and prosecuting federal crimes.
governance_structure: Executive department. The Attorney General is appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate and is the head of the Department of Justice.

name: Federal Bureau of Investigation
notes: Domestic intelligence and security service operating within the Department of Justice.
governance_structure: Within the Department of Justice. The Director is appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate and may not serve more than one ten-year term.

name: Environmental Protection Agency
notes: Independent agency tasked with environmental protection and enforcing federal pollution laws.
governance_structure: Established by Reorganization Plan No. 3 of 1970 rather than by an authorizing statute; transmitted to Congress on July 9, 1970, and the agency began operations on December 2, 1970. Created as a free-standing agency rather than a unit of an existing department. The Administrator and Deputy Administrator are appointed by the President, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate.

name: Food and Drug Administration
notes: HHS agency regulating food, drugs, biologics, medical devices, cosmetics, and tobacco.
governance_structure: Within the Department of Health and Human Services. The Commissioner of Food and Drugs is appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate.

name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
notes: HHS public-health agency responsible for disease control, prevention, and outbreak response.
governance_structure: Within the Department of Health and Human Services. The Director is appointed by the President, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate, and also serves as Administrator of the Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry. The Senate-confirmation requirement was added by Pub. L. 117-328 § 2101(a) (Dec. 29, 2022).

name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
notes: Independent agency regulating securities markets and enforcing federal securities laws.
governance_structure: Independent regulatory commission. Five commissioners appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate, serving five-year terms. Not more than three may be members of the same political party, and appointments alternate between parties as nearly as practicable.

name: Internal Revenue Service
notes: Treasury bureau responsible for collecting federal taxes and administering the Internal Revenue Code.
governance_structure: Within the Department of the Treasury. The Commissioner of Internal Revenue is appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate for a five-year term.

name: United States Department of Defense
notes: Cabinet-level executive department coordinating national security and the U.S. armed forces.
governance_structure: Executive department. The Secretary of Defense is appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate. A commissioned officer may not be appointed within seven years of leaving active duty below grade O-7, or within ten years at grade O-7 or above.

name: United States Department of State
notes: Cabinet-level department conducting U.S. foreign policy and managing diplomatic relations.
governance_structure: Executive department, established by acts of Congress in 1789, headed by the Secretary of State.

name: United States Department of the Treasury
notes: Cabinet-level department managing federal finances, currency, taxation, and economic policy.
governance_structure: Executive department. The Secretary of the Treasury is appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate.

name: Federal Reserve System
notes: The U.S. central banking system; sets monetary policy via the FOMC and supervises member banks.
governance_structure: Board of Governors of seven members appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate, serving fourteen-year terms. At least one member must have experience working in or supervising community banks with under $10 billion in assets.

name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
notes: Independent agency created post-2008 to regulate consumer-facing financial products and services.
governance_structure: Independent bureau within the Federal Reserve System, headed by a single Director rather than a commission. The Director is appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate for a five-year term.

name: National Labor Relations Board
notes: Independent agency enforcing the National Labor Relations Act and adjudicating union-employer disputes.
governance_structure: Independent agency. Five members appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate, serving five-year terms. The statute sets no partisan-balance requirement.
